text: Project Blueprint 是 DSH 的 AI 编程规范技能插件，通过注册自定义 FileSystemSkillProvider 技能目录，让 DSH 按需加载七步项目初始化流程。它引导 agent 发现项目文件与技术栈，生成或补齐 AGENTS.md、文档骨架、CI 门禁、Git 规范和测试策略，并支持已有项目增量完善。适合希望快速为新代码库建立可维护开发约定的开发者；插件本身无需额外 API Key，未知依赖的流程会提示 agent 使用联网搜索。

Project Blueprint registers bundled skills with DSH. Its seven-step workflow helps agents inspect a codebase and create or update AGENTS.md, docs, CI gates, Git conventions, and testing guidance. It needs no API key; unknown dependency discovery may use web search.
想给新项目一次性建立 AGENTS.md、文档和 CI 规范
能根据项目现有文件自动判断技术栈并生成开发约定吗
我想给老项目补齐缺失的开发文档，又不覆盖已有规则
帮我为代码库整理测试制度、Git 约定和持续集成门禁
有没有技能能按需加载项目初始化的每一步操作说明
让 AI 按识别出的语言和框架定制项目规范
I want an agent to bootstrap project conventions from the files already in my repo.
Can a skill generate CI gates, docs structure, and a testing policy for my codebase?
Project Blueprint 的功能「七步初始化流程」：技能按项目初始化、规则装配、文档、Git、CI、测试和持续维护组织步骤。用户提出初始化需求后，agent 按索引加载相应步骤。
Project Blueprint 的功能「项目文件与技术栈发现」：流程引导 agent 扫描构建和配置文件，分类并推断语言、框架和依赖；未知项可继续联网搜索。
Project Blueprint 的功能「技能目录接入 DSH」：插件通过 skills 服务注册 FileSystemSkillProvider，并将包内 skills 目录作为自定义技能根目录。
Project Blueprint 使用前须知：未知依赖的分类流程会指示 agent 发起 WebSearch；实际是否联网取决于宿主 agent 提供的搜索能力。

project-blueprint README · What is this?：Project Blueprint is a reusable AI agent skill that transforms any new project into an AI-ready codebase in one sentence. It's not a static template — it's an **autonomous discovery engine**: scan your project files, intelligently classify dependencies, and dynamically assemble a customized AGENTS.md, documentation skeleton, CI/CD pipeline, and testing policy from a 95-entry component knowledge base.

Just say: **"Initialize this project's development standards"** and the agent does the rest.
project-blueprint README · Quick Install：```bash
project-blueprint README · Global (GitHub)：npx skills add shuguang1994/project-blueprint
project-blueprint README · China (Gitee mirror, no proxy needed)：npx skills add https://gitee.com/shuguang1994/project-blueprint.git

project-blueprint README · Update later：npx skills update project-blueprint
```

**DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin**:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:shuguang1994/project-blueprint'
```

Supported agents: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Windsurf, Trae, OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness, and 28+ more.

project-blueprint README · Why：**AGENTS.md is now an industry standard in 2026** — used by 60,000+ open-source repos, co-promoted by OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, and Microsoft. 76% of developers use AI coding assistants (Stack Overflow 2025), but without AGENTS.md, AI agents are like "new hires with no onboarding" — producing inconsistent code styles, broken architecture, and failing CI.

project-blueprint README · Why：**Industry data**: Anthropic benchmarks show AGENTS.md reduces wrong-pattern rewrites by **40-60%**. But writing a quality AGENTS.md by hand takes half a day to a full day — repeated for every new project.

project-blueprint README · Why：**Project Blueprint's approach**: No preset templates. Autonomous scanning → intelligent classification → dynamic assembly. The AGENTS.md you get reflects your project's actual tech stack. And it's the only tool that generates AGENTS.md + docs skeleton + CI pipeline + testing policy + Git conventions — all from one sentence.

project-blueprint README · Web Search Fallback：> Web fallback covers two phases: **generation** (web search for unknown deps/modules) + **coding** (the generated AGENTS.md requires verifying third-party library APIs/versions against official docs before writing code).

project-blueprint README · What Makes It Different：- **Autonomous discovery, not preset** — scans what your project actually has
- **3-tier classification** — exact match → pattern heuristic → web search
- **Full-stack coverage** — AGENTS.md + docs + CI + testing policy + Git, one sentence
- **Incremental-friendly** — auto-detects existing projects, adds only what's missing
- **Monorepo closest-file-wins** — multi sub-project repos get a root + per-package `AGENTS.md`, matching the official AGENTS.md semantics
- **Self-evolving** — generated AGENTS.md is not a dead file; it teaches the AI to maintain itself as the project grows
- **MCP-ready tooling** — auto-recommends MCP tools + combos from your stack, with an installable doc that never ships outdated commands
- **AI mistake prevention + BUG→conventions feedback loop** — built-in 7-category 27-item AI common-mistakes KB injected at init; conventions-deficiency bugs auto-feed back into AGENTS.md and B-01, so conventions evolve with real practice
- **Conventions that don't rot** — not just static docs: every blocking red line ships with an executable check, the gate registry has a single source of truth and a constitution self-chec
